items.label: Style profile
items.help: Apply a versioned set of settings. Individual settings override the selected profile.

items.label: Preferred width
items.help: The column wrapping aims for. Off keeps your line breaks inside brackets. On, a bracket group that fits stays on one line; one that does not breaks after the bracket, after each comma and before the closer.
items.also: Prettier printWidth, Black line-length, clang-format ColumnLimit, rustfmt max_width

items.label: Trailing comma forces a break
items.help: With wrapping on, a group whose last item ends in a comma always breaks, even when it would fit.
items.also: Black and Ruff magic trailing comma, dart format preserve

items.label: Indent with
items.help: Tabs write one tab per level. Alignment past the levels, such as arguments under an open parenthesis, still uses spaces, so it survives any tab width.
items.also: Prettier useTabs, clang-format UseTab, rustfmt hard_tabs, EditorConfig indent_style

items.label: Indent width
items.help: Columns per level. With tabs, the width a tab counts for when aligning continued lines.
items.also: Prettier tabWidth, clang-format IndentWidth, rustfmt tab_spaces, EditorConfig indent_size

items.label: Continuation indent
items.help: How far a continued line is indented when it is not aligned: after a bracket that ends its line, or always when alignment is off.

items.label: Align after open bracket
items.help: Lines continued inside a bracket line up under its first item. Off, they take the continuation indent.

items.label: Align operands
items.help: A continued operand of a binary expression lines up with the first operand. Off, it takes the continuation indent.

items.label: Indent case labels
items.help: case labels sit one level inside their switch. Off, they line up with the switch.
items.also: clang-format IndentCaseLabels, odinfmt indent_cases, swift-format indentSwitchCaseLabels

items.label: Indent foreign contents
items.help: Indent declarations one level inside this kind of block. Braces retain the enclosing indentation.

items.label: Indent when contents
items.help: Indent declarations one level inside this kind of block. Braces retain the enclosing indentation.

items.label: Tab display width
items.help: Columns displayed by a tab; zero uses Indent width. Tabs indent and spaces align.

items.label: Opening braces
items.help: Keep opening block braces where you wrote them, attach them to their header, or place them on the next line. Literal braces keep their list layout.
items.also: clang-format BreakBeforeBraces, Rider brace layout, dprint bracePosition

items.label: Body braces
items.help: Keep, require, or omit braces around one simple statement in an if, else or while body. Empty bodies, multiple statements, nested controls and comments retain their braces.

items.label: Empty blocks
items.help: An empty block as you wrote it, collapsed to {} or expanded over two lines.

items.label: Keep one-line blocks
items.help: A block you wrote on one line, such as if (x) { return y; }, stays on one line.

items.label: Following else
items.help: Select the following else policy. Keep or inherit preserves the corresponding current setting.

items.label: Unbraced body placement
items.help: Place one-statement control bodies independently of brace presence. Comments and grammar continuation hazards retain safe line breaks.

items.label: Semantic validation

items.label: Statement paragraphs
items.help: Logical groups use SEGMENT's four-phase action-unit algorithm adapted to Chibi: candidate units, overlap resolution, similarity refinement and compatible singleton merges. Syntax mode uses structural cuts. Existing sections, comments and protected text are retained.
